label: 1-2 steps after an early original-phase k (steps 2-5)
explanation: A k-detector with a short delay, limited to the original phase. It fires on the one or two input steps right after a k, but only at steps 2-5 of the original sequence (prev_tok==k gives 14x lift and holds 69% of activation mass; prev2_tok==k gives 9x lift). The strongest activations, around 0.9-1.0 of max, come at step 4 when k was at position 2, i.e. two steps after the k; the step right after the k reaches about 0.55-0.68. It is silent during the copy phase, at steps 0-1 and at step 7 or later, and when k is the very first token (k then k-follower at t=2 is not active). Activity at the delimiter step is negligible. The missed activations, about 14% of mass, are low-magnitude firings at steps 4-5 with no recent k, which suggests a weak position-dependent baseline. Input identity otherwise matters little.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: k, 2, v, w, h, e; least: f, x, 0, i) and the input two steps back (most: k, p, 2, b, r, j; least: i, 0, x, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, t=5, t=3.
